title: 第2647章 全民修仙破除弑天神咒第2646章 苍隗的阴谋
lines: 控制天冥老祖，炼化两大本源。
苍隗眸光微闪，开始在心中盘算着阴谋。
他意念微动。
唰！
唰！
虚空中，六道身穿金甲的仙帝蓦然浮现。
“你们全力探查幽冥局势的情报，无需参战，但要时刻注意天冥老鬼与唐青冥的动向。”
“记住。”
苍隗凝声道：“只需要收集情报即可。”
六名仙帝点头，很快就化作流光朝远处掠去。
苍隗思忖片刻，手捏法印，运转帝神秘术，将此地虚无空间的入口挪向远处。
就算是自己的心腹，他也不会完全信任。
“我如今是太虚境巅峰，只差半步就能晋升天古，绝对不能出任何差池。”
“唐青冥此人诡异无比，暂时先不管他，全力针对天冥老鬼和那两道本源……”
苍隗目光凌厉，而后整片虚空重归寂静。
接下来一段时间。
幽冥界域仍旧是战乱纷纷。
以魏凌啸为首的天冥军团，开始对帝神大军展开搏杀。
鬼域军团与人族军团联合起来，胜多败少，多名神使被击毙，帝神战线节节败退。
而范洲所部，算是帝神大军中为数不多能打胜仗的精锐，而且多次击溃鬼域大军与人族大军的围剿。
一时间。
范洲在帝神大军中的威望也越来越高。
而在大战爆发之际。
唐明一边炼化苍隗的分身灵韵，一边陆续从人境昆仑墟带来了超过八十万人族修士。
这八十万人族修士，修为都不高。
但这些都不是问题，在冥渊冢的时间流速下，以及战争资源的掠夺下，他们的实力正在飞速攀升。
同时。
人族军武司也开启大练兵时代。
除了姜龙武、柳白率领的人族精锐，与魏凌啸联手在正面厮杀外，大夏军武司也会率领诸多小型军团，采取游击战术，一边截杀帝神大军的后勤线，一边磨砺军队的作战能力。
不止于此。
随着华峰的回归。
content_en:
Control the ancestor Tian Ming and refine the two sources.
Cang Wei's eyes flashed slightly, and he began to calculate the conspiracy in his heart.
His thoughts moved slightly.
Uh-huh!
Uh-huh!
In the void, six immortal emperors wearing golden armor suddenly appeared.
"You will do your best to explore the intelligence of Netherworld's situation. There is no need to participate in the battle, but you must always pay attention to the movements of Old Ghost Tianming and Tang Qingming."
"Remember."
Cang Wei said in a concentrated voice: "We just need to collect information."
"Yes."
The six Immortal Emperors nodded and soon turned into streams of light and swept away into the distance.
Cang Wei thought for a moment, pressed the seal with his hand, and used the emperor's mysterious technique to move the entrance to the void space farther away.
Even if he is his confidant, he will not completely trust him.
"I am now at the pinnacle of Taixu Realm. I am only half a step away from being promoted to Tiangu. I must not make any mistakes."
"Tang Qingming is a very weird person. Let's ignore him for the time being and focus on targeting the old ghost Tian Ming and the two origins..."
Cang Wei's eyes were sharp, and then the whole void returned to silence.
…
The next period of time.
The Nether Realm is still full of wars.
The Tian Ming Legion, headed by Wei Lingxiao, began to fight against the Emperor God's army.
The Ghost Realm Legion and the Human Race Legion united and won more than they lost. Many divine envoys were killed, and the Emperor-God battle line was retreating steadily.
Fan Zhou's troops are among the few elites in the Emperor God's army who can win battles, and have repeatedly defeated the encirclement and suppression attacks by the Ghost Domain Army and the Human Race Army.
For a while.
Fan Zhou's prestige among the emperor's army is also getting higher and higher.
…
And when the war broke out.
While Tang Ming was refining Cang Wei's avatar, he successively brought more than 800,000 monks from the human realm of Kunlun Ruins.
The cultivation level of these 800,000 ethnic monks is not high.
But these are not problems. Under the speed of time in the Abyss Tomb and the plunder of war resources, their strength is rising rapidly.
at the same time.
The Human Race Military Division has also begun an era of large-scale military training.
In addition to the human elites led by Jiang Longwu and Liu Bai, who join forces with Wei Lingxiao to fight in the front, the Great Xia Army Wu Si will also lead many small legions to adopt guerrilla tactics, intercepting the logistics line of the Emperor God's army while honing the army's combat capabilities.
It doesn't stop there.
With the return of Huafeng.
title_en: Chapter 2647: Nationwide Cultivation of Immortals to Break the God-Killing Curse Chapter 2646: Cang Wei’s Conspiracy
